module: Flowgraph node "On introPopupCareerClosed" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Detects the closing of the career intro window. Outputs: closed (one-frame impulse) and id (any, id of the closed window, nil otherwise).

work.desc: Every frame: closed to false and id to nil, then applies and clears the flags.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Hook: raises closed and stores the window id if provided.

_afterTrigger.desc: Clears the flags after the trigger.
